system.description: Also at 5th level, once per turn you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. By spending 2 Superiority Die you can take one additional action on your turn, which can only be used to Cast a Jutsu. This action cannot be used to cast a jutsu of the same casting discipline you previously cast on this turn and you cannot spend your action for the remainder of the turn to cast a jutsu of the same casting discipline as you cast with this feature. If you would use this feature again before you complete a rest, increase the number of Superiority Die you spend to activate this feature by +1 for each time used beyond the first.

roll.note: One extra action this turn to cast a jutsu of a different discipline. Each further use before a rest costs +1 die.
